settings.editor: Decks take more sun, snow and foot traffic than any other part of the house. We restore them and keep them looking good.

background_image.alt: Freshly stained deck and log railing

settings.editor:
A deck finish only lasts if the wood underneath is sound and clean. We repair what needs it, take off old, failing stain, and prepare the boards so the new finish soaks in properly.

Then we apply a penetrating stain suited to the wood and the exposure, and tell you when it'll need a maintenance coat.

• Cleaning and stripping old finishes
  • Sanding and board replacement
  • Rot repair on boards, beams and posts
  • Penetrating stain on decks, railings and stairs
  • Maintenance coats to keep it looking new
We look at the work in person, talk through colors and products, and give you a clear written estimate with no hidden charges.
Floors, furnishings, fixtures and landscaping are covered. Surfaces are cleaned, repaired and prepped to the manufacturer's specifications.
Premium coatings applied the right way, with enough coats for our dry, high-altitude climate. When we spray, we back-brush for a proper bond.
We clean up every day, then walk the finished job with you before we call it done. Your project lead is your contact the whole way.
Free written estimates across the Vail, Roaring Fork and Eagle valleys. We'll call within one business day to set up a walkthrough.
